parent_results.v09_gate_d_conclusion: species/photo-disjoint 250 species x 100 records: type-I passed, shared A2 power 0.244, Wilson lower 0.20840, deployment adequacy failed

scientific_question: Can the loss of shared-signal detectability at higher record density be explained by fixed-k nearest-neighbour graphs shrinking their edge scale, thereby reducing the fraction and magnitude of edges that resolve a broad shared transition?
causal_identification_boundary: The v08 and v09 panels use different species cohorts, so their raw power contrast cannot identify a density effect. The primary v0.10 audit therefore uses only the failed v0.9 250-species x 100-record cohort and creates nested deterministic geometry-only subsets within the same species cohort.

nested_density_design.priority: within each species sort frozen records by SHA256(seed|species|source_photo_id), ties by source_photo_id; take prefixes

constant_neighbor_fraction.origin: 0.15 is fixed prospectively as 3/20, the neighbour fraction of the original 20-record reserve design; it is not estimated from v0.9 performance
constant_neighbor_fraction.candidate_status: development diagnostic only, not qualified and not selectable for empirical use

geometry_only_metrics: equal-species mean and median raw kNN edge length in km
edge length after one pooled affine standardization of each nested geometry
shared-transition observability using the existing noise-free Gate-I shared hyperplane audit
equal-species mean shared edge contrast across random directions
fraction of directions with at least one nontrivial edge contrast per species

predeclared_interpretation.fixed_k_signature: Mechanism is supported if increasing n under fixed k=3 systematically shrinks edge scale and shared-transition observability in the same v0.9 species cohort.
predeclared_interpretation.fraction_scaled_signature: The edge-scale explanation is further supported if k/n=0.15 materially stabilizes edge scale and observability relative to fixed k=3. This remains development evidence and does not qualify the graph rule.
predeclared_interpretation.no_signature: If edge scale or observability does not decline with fixed k, do not attribute the v0.9 power loss to graph localization; preserve the failure and seek another geometry mechanism.
